ruling.recommended_action: Refer to a human reviewer: obtain the full untimed-thinned GPS trace and the "off-route segment" facts (gps-detour-* with extra_km and segment start/end) that this case file omitted; verify whether the driver's Seletar Expressway detour overlaps the LTA Accident incident (reported 17:16, ~1.6 km before the incident point) and recompute the metered meter-vs-quoted gap per RD-2. If the untimed leg is confirmed off-route with no exemption, note the RD-1 breach regardless of recoverable amount.

segment_findings.reason: The terminal leg of the trip (from ~17:40–17:44 onward) departs from the quoted polyline's 9.5 km straight Tampines Expressway leg, which no sampled GPS point traverses; the trace reverses near 1.4019,103.8276 and returns west, consistent with the driver's stated Seletar Expressway diversion. LTA also lists an Accident on the Seletar Expressway (on the quoted line) reported 17:16, before the apparent diversion, at ~1.6 km from the turnback point. But this record contains no computed gps-detour-* segment with start/end and extra_km, and the GPS is thinned to every 6th sample, so I cannot determine whether this is a genuine off-route segment or a thinning/closure artefact, nor whether the first ~17 minutes of the metered trip (driver_statement cites only the Seletar accident) are explained. RD-1/RD-4/RD-5 findings cannot be settled from the available record; escalate for the full trace and segment facts.
